page.layout: One column of verse, centred under the heading. Above it: the division title "EPIGRAMMATA." with a printed ornament band and the subtitle "ALIVD." Below the verse: the author's initials "G. R. JC." at right, and the catchword "IN" at lower right. No margin text.

p.i: Noricus en pinxit Zeusis super æthera notus
Mentem admirandam, & quæ catera summa fuêre,
Historico melius quis dicere chromate, dic, quis
IMHOFIO pronepote queat? cui credere fas est,
Namque bonâ comperta fide producit in auras.
Quod pietatis amor te jussit solvere, JANE,
Rite exolvisti: merito hæc tibi Sparta relicta est.

page.notes: The first letter of "Mirandam" is a large woodcut-style initial M, joined to the word. Small capitals are set as capitals: BILIBALDI, PIRCKEIMERūM, DÜRERUS, IMHOFIO, JANE. The tilde over the u of PIRCKEIMERūM stands for a left-out m. Red or orange underlines run through several lines of the verse; they are marks added to the copy, not printed text, and are left out. A small "C" stands at the top centre above the heading and a small "c" at the left edge of the page; these are stray marks, not printed signatures, and are left out. The rest of the page is clear.
